name: Ulfat
real_life_inspiration: Represents Rehman Dakait's real wife. Real Rehman Dakait did have a family in Lyari. The film uses Ulfat to humanise Rehman and show the domestic cost of the criminal empire — her presence grounds the gang war in human consequence rather than pure crime drama.

inspiration_notes.narrative_function: Ulfat is the moral witness to Rehman's world. Her character likely plays a role in scenes where the human cost of the gang war and the ISI patronage system becomes visible — women and families are the silent casualties of the Lyari conflict.
inspiration_notes.real_context: Rehman Dakait's family remained in Lyari after his 2009 death. The People's Aman Committee's criminal empire created devastating civilian consequences — thousands displaced, hundreds killed in the gang war years.
inspiration_notes.oracle_classification: Non-playable. No adversary model. Relevant to belief_node context — her wellbeing is a pressure lever that adversaries (Dakait's rivals, ISI) could use against Rehman.
